title: Maxton Hall Season 3: final-season trailer out; on Prime Video from 9 Dec, two episodes a week, finale 23 Dec
headline: Maxton Hall's Final Season Trailer Is Out; Prime Video From 9 Dec
caption:
Prime Video has released the official trailer for the third and final season of Maxton Hall, its German romance drama. Season 3 streams from Wednesday, 9 December: episodes 1 and 2 that day, two more on 16 December, and the last two on 23 December, when the series ends.

The season adapts Save Us, the third book in Mona Kasten's trilogy. Ruby has been suspended from Maxton Hall, her Oxford plans are at risk, and she and James try to clear her name. Harriet Herbig-Matten and Damian Hardung return as Ruby and James.

Seasons 1 and 2 are streaming on Prime Video now.

Will you watch two episodes a week as they drop, or wait until 23 December and binge all six?

Sources: Amazon, Screen Realm, Gulf News
